repositories.name: Baseline
repositories.purpose: Fleet map, durable decisions, evidence, corpus, and public discovery.
repositories.current_focus: Keep the sovereign fleet understandable while turning the five Quest design intents into durable authority.
repositories.next_outcome: Publish an automatically refreshed fleet status surface and land the five intent documents with PD-4 evidence labels.
repositories.done_when: Users and builders can see current repository health, next outcomes, and cross-repository pins from one public page.

repositories.name: NetworkSense
repositories.purpose: NetworkSense mod, HUD, game-independent tests, and mod release lane.
repositories.current_focus: Preserve the sovereign mod boundary and its exact package and artifact gates.
repositories.next_outcome: Remove the bounded HTTP test's observed nondeterminism while keeping the 166-case release proof green.
repositories.done_when: Repeated focused and full test runs are stable and the verifiable mod bundle lane remains green.

repositories.name: Lumberjacks Platform
repositories.purpose: Gateway, services, Companion, Workbench, live FieldLab, and deployment lanes.
repositories.current_focus: Recover the platform's governance and public projection after the repository split.
repositories.next_outcome: Restore CI, re-affirm the roadmap focus, and correct every stale Workbench ownership promise.
repositories.done_when: All five CI jobs pass and the hosted Workbench names only current sovereign owners and paths.

repositories.name: Comfy Quest
repositories.purpose: Quest Contracts, Runtime, Lab, Studio, generators, and creator release assets.
repositories.current_focus: Build the five-intent identity and evidence spine across Contracts, Runtime, and Studio.
repositories.next_outcome: Close the Studio-to-Live creator loop with immutable development revisions and correlated runtime receipts.
repositories.done_when: One creator can publish, activate, observe, revise, and explain one Event without restarting the game.
repositories.blocker: The final validation lap requires the operator-controlled OMEN game client and private world.

repositories.name: Sovereign Shards
repositories.purpose: Greenfield shard manager, portal router, sidecar, and community bot architecture.
repositories.current_focus: Keep the architecture honest while preparing the manual three-client substrate gate.
repositories.next_outcome: Run the documented gateway and two-shard proof with three independently controlled Steam clients.
repositories.done_when: Both migration falsifiers pass and only the manual substrate is promoted from UNVERIFIED to VERIFIED.
repositories.blocker: The proof requires three controlled Steam clients and an authorized live field-test session.

repositories.name: Isolate
repositories.purpose: Private MCP kernel, container contracts, and disposable lab runtime.
repositories.current_focus: Keep the MCP and container boundary green while resolving the older developer-tool charter.
repositories.next_outcome: Reconcile the current repository map with the retained toolset and add repository identity and no-reach-in guards.
repositories.done_when: One durable decision names the owned tools and CI proves the resulting boundary with positive and negative fixtures.
